caption:
Answer harm with good. It can turn an enemy into a friend.

Allah tells us that good and evil are not equal, and asks us to push back evil with what is better. The verse says the one you were at odds with can become like a close friend.

Surah Fussilat 41:34

Who is one person you could answer with kindness this week?

#quranreels #kindness #goodcharacter #forgiveness

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: Good and evil are not equal. Repel evil with what is good; the one whom you have enmity with will become as if he was a close friend (Surah Fussilat 41:34)
